title: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas

novelty_points.claim: 提出Attention U-Net，将可学习的注意力门加入U-Net，抑制无关区域并突出医学图像中的目标结构。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes Attention U-Net, integrating learnable attention gates into U-Net to suppress irrelevant regions and highlight target structures in medical images.
technical_features: 注意力门学习抑制无关区域并突出任务相关特征。
结合输入激活与来自更粗尺度的门控信号计算注意力系数。
使用注意力系数缩放输入特征，以支持目标结构分割。
technical_features_en: Attention gates learn to suppress irrelevant regions and highlight task-relevant features.
Computes attention coefficients from input activations and a gating signal from a coarser scale.
Scales input features with attention coefficients for target structure segmentation.
